items.sentence: Software already runs much of the market, but running is by no means the same as answering for it. Provided that many firms rely on one model, it can become a single point of failure, and their errors may move in lockstep. Most participants the IMF asked want a human in the loop, partly because someone has to be held accountable. A token counts as money only as long as a community accepts it. What remains to be seen is whether machines could ever be that community. Standard contracts cut both ways. Don’t read too much into a toy, with the caveat that it shows what could happen, not what will.
